card.name: The word every in dosing intervals
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "every" right after a dose or amount, introducing a time interval such as every 8 hours. Also fires weakly on "of" or "the" after a noun in encyclopedia-style definitions.

modes.label: Every before interval
modes.description: "every" follows a dose or quantity and starts a repeat interval.

modes.label: Linking word in definitions
modes.description: "of" or "the" after a noun in dictionary or encyclopedia entries.
modes.example: [1913 Webster] Spanish nectarine, the plumlike fruit<< of>> the West Indian tree Chrysobalan
